difficulty_reason: The endpoint adjoint reduces to a weighted irrational-rotation operator. Its kernel is characterized by exponential twisting and Fourier uniqueness; exact observability follows from rational-delay Toeplitz inverses with a size-independent bound, while dense eigenvalues approaching zero obstruct exact control.
